    Profile

    Mocca is a Wind Shaman of the Fuu faction from Saga. Her summoning was based on memories of a time once passed, achieved by using a catalyst that channeled Ouroboros' power. Though she may come across as cool, calm, and collected, a strong sense of justice burns brightly in her heart. She simply cannot look away from those in need.

    Origin: Saga Region
